name: Darrowshire
summary: Darrowshire lies in ruins in the southern hills of the Eastern Plaguelands. Once a peaceful hamlet of Lordaeron, it made a desperate stand against the Scourge during the Third War. Shattered timbers, restless spirits, and bitter memories remain.

sections.title: A Tragic Stand
sections.body:
Darrowshire's villagers fought the Scourge during the Third War. Before plague consumed northern Lordaeron, the humble settlement stood beneath the southern cliffs. Marduk Blackpool, a death knight, and Horgus the Ravager, a ghoul lord, led the besieging force.

The villagers and local defenders held the line for a time, though the odds were impossible. Then their defense broke, and the Scourge slaughtered the town down to the last soul. Many fallen defenders were raised as ghouls to swell the Scourge's ranks. Darrowshire remains an empty memorial to those who died there.

sections.title: Echoes of the Battle
sections.body: Darrowshire's ruins still bear the weight of the slaughter. The living abandoned the village long ago, but spectral remnants of its townspeople remain trapped there. Travelers report strange sights, including ghostly reenactments of the battle unfolding in silence. Sorrow still clings to the ground, a reminder of what the Scourge took from the kingdom.

faq.answer: The Scourge destroyed Darrowshire during the Third War. Marduk Blackpool, a death knight, and Horgus the Ravager, a ghoul lord, led the assault. Their forces overwhelmed the defenders and slaughtered the inhabitants, leaving the village in ruins.

faq.q: Who were the leaders of the Scourge attack on Darrowshire?
faq.answer: Marduk Blackpool, a death knight, and Horgus the Ravager, a ghoul lord, led the Scourge assault on Darrowshire. Their forces broke the village's defenders and destroyed the settlement.

aliases: why are there spirits in darrowshire
faq.answer: The slaughter bound the spirits of Darrowshire's fallen to the earth. Ghostly figures linger among the ruins, and the battle itself sometimes plays out again in spectral form, leaving the dead trapped in their final moments.

faq.q: What became of the villagers who died defending the town?
faq.answer: The Scourge slaughtered Darrowshire's defenders, and many were reanimated as ghouls. They were forced to serve the army that destroyed their homes.

angles.text: As a human of the Alliance, Darrowshire recalls the devastation inflicted on Lordaeron and the ordinary folk who made a hopeless stand to defend their families.
As a paladin, you can bring the purifying Light to the Plaguelands, strike down the undead, and lay tortured spirits to rest.
